reason: Hypothesis A proposes a specific, testable intervention (adding 1–2 wt% Cu) with a clear mechanism (grain-boundary nanoprecipitates that impede dislocations but are smaller than domain walls), directly addresses the strength–magnetocaloric trade-off, and extends prior Cu-precipitate concepts to a new material system, whereas Hypothesis B is overly generic (a controlled aging treatment) and essentially restates the known nanoprecipitate approach without specifying how to achieve it in MnNiSi.
